{{- /* layouts/_partials/pagination.html — variant dispatcher (v2.2+) [CAP:pagination] → see caps/pagination/manifest.json Routes to the active variant partial based on params.pagination.variant: "simple" (default) — prev / page-count / next "numbered" — numbered page buttons with first/last Activation: [params] pagination.variant = "numbered" in config.toml */ -}} {{- $variant := "simple" -}} {{- with .Site.Params.pagination -}} {{- $variant = .variant | default "simple" -}} {{- end -}} {{- if eq $variant "numbered" -}} {{- partial "pagination/numbered.html" . -}} {{- else -}} {{- partial "pagination/simple.html" . -}} {{- end -}}
